title: Google Cloud Architecture Framework — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces the Architecture Review Lifecycle: from business requirements submission through 5-pillar scorecard evaluation to final deployment approval.
routing_rationale: Structured architecture reviews evaluate risks against formal checklists across each pillar, producing actionable Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).

nodes.label: RFC Architecture Proposal
nodes.detail: Engineers submit RFC detailing new event processing service on Google Cloud.

nodes.label: Security Scorecard Check
nodes.detail: Reviews customer data classification, encryption key rotation, and perimeter ingress.

nodes.label: Reliability & SLO Audit
nodes.detail: Validates regional redundancy, circuit breakers, and RTO/RPO disaster recovery procedures.

nodes.label: FinOps Sizing Model
nodes.detail: Reviews projected spend against cost center allocation and commits.

nodes.label: Signed Architecture Record
nodes.detail: Architecture Decision Record recorded in Git; triggers Terraform release pipeline.

steps.title: Multi-Pillar Scorecard Review
steps.action: Proposal evaluated in parallel across Security, Reliability, and Cost pillars.
steps.why_traversal: Parallel reviews identify trade-offs before code and infrastructure are committed.

steps.title: Consensus & Formal Approval
steps.action: All three leads endorse design; ADR is signed and checked into Git repository.
steps.why_traversal: Maintains immutable architectural governance trail for auditability.

scenarios.label: Security Gate Blocks Unencrypted Public Storage
scenarios.root_cause: Proposal attempted to use public GCS bucket for staging client uploads.
scenarios.diverted_path: Automated security linter flags violation; ARB rejects design.
scenarios.recovery: Revise proposal to use Private Service Connect with signed upload URLs.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

summary: Traces the Architecture Review Lifecycle: from business requirements submission through 5-pillar scorecard evaluation to final deployment approval.
